_comment: Public facts for each Tara Salon branch — the one source for the pages (rendered by lib/pages.js), the footer and the booking page. Money and calendar settings are NOT here: they live server-side in config/branches.js. A null field is a placeholder still to be supplied by the salon; the pages show it as «удахгүй нэмэгдэнэ», never as an invented value. workHours are opening/closing hours (24h) and decide which start times booking offers.
